# Engine errors

Every error the engine program raises, from its IDL. When an SDK call fails, `client.explain(error)` returns the code and name of the engine error behind it, or `null` if the engine raised none. Retry later `yes` means the cause can pass with time, so the same call can succeed later.

| Code | Name | Retry later | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 6000 | `Overflow` | no | an amount is too large for the arithmetic |
| 6001 | `DivideByZero` | no | the arithmetic divided by zero |
| 6002 | `Truncated` | no | the instruction data was cut short |
| 6003 | `NonCanonical` | no | the instruction data was not encoded canonically |
| 6004 | `UnknownKind` | no | the intent kind is not one the program knows |
| 6005 | `UnknownStatus` | no | the intent holds a status this version does not know |
| 6006 | `InvalidParams` | no | the order terms are inconsistent |
| 6007 | `AmountMismatch` | no | the amounts do not match what the intent escrows |
| 6008 | `InsufficientOutput` | yes | the fill pays less than the intent requires right now |
| 6009 | `InvalidTransition` | no | the intent is not in a state that allows this |
| 6010 | `IntentExpired` | no | the intent has expired and can no longer be filled |
| 6011 | `NotExpired` | yes | the intent has not expired yet |
| 6012 | `NonceUsed` | no | this nonce is already used |
| 6013 | `NonceOutOfWindow` | no | this nonce is outside the owner's 256-nonce window or inside the agent nonce lanes |
| 6014 | `NonceRegression` | no | the nonce base can only move forward |
| 6015 | `Unauthorized` | no | a signer or a named account does not match the one recorded on-chain (owner, rent payer, mandate agent, admin, guardian or upgrade authority) |
| 6016 | `CreatePaused` | yes | creating intents is paused by the guardian or admin |
| 6017 | `KindDisabled` | no | this intent kind is not enabled |
| 6018 | `UnknownKindBits` | no | the kind mask names kinds the program does not know |
| 6019 | `InvalidPauseFlags` | no | the pause flags are empty or name pauses the program does not know |
| 6020 | `FeeTooHigh` | no | the configured fee exceeds the program's maximum |
| 6021 | `NotPendingAdmin` | no | only the proposed admin can accept the admin role |
| 6022 | `ExpiryNotInFuture` | no | the expiry must be later than the current chain time |
| 6023 | `SameMint` | no | the input and output mints must differ |
| 6024 | `MintNotAllowed` | no | this mint cannot be used: it has a token extension the program refuses |
| 6025 | `RefundNotCanonical` | no | refunds go only to the owner's canonical token account |
| 6026 | `ReceiverNotAllowed` | no | the receiver account is not owned by the named receiver authority, the authority is an engine account, or (for a mandate) the receiver is not an account the owner controls |
| 6027 | `AuctionOutlivesExpiry` | no | the dutch auction must end at or before the intent expires |
| 6028 | `FillPaused` | yes | fills are paused by the guardian or admin, and with them new claims and stand-by joins |
| 6029 | `FeeAccountNotCanonical` | no | a fee must go to its payee's canonical token account (the treasury's, the agent's or the judge's) |
| 6030 | `FeeAccountMissing` | no | a fee account was not passed: the treasury's, agent's or judge's at fill, or the relayer's at a signed create |
| 6031 | `SolverOutputNotAllowed` | no | the solver's output account is not acceptable for this fill |
| 6032 | `SigProgram` | no | the signature instruction must come from the Ed25519 program |
| 6033 | `SigHeader` | no | the Ed25519 instruction is malformed |
| 6034 | `SigPubkey` | no | the signature was made by a different key than the owner |
| 6035 | `SigMessage` | no | the signed message does not match this intent |
| 6036 | `KindMismatch` | no | the instruction does not match the intent's kind |
| 6037 | `ResultOutOfBounds` | no | the attested result is outside the intent's bounds |
| 6038 | `SigMissing` | no | the Ed25519 signature instruction is missing |
| 6039 | `InvalidDomain` | no | the config domain must not be zero |
| 6040 | `SignatureExpired` | no | the signed intent passed its submit-by time |
| 6041 | `FlashCpi` | no | a flash fill cannot be started from inside another program |
| 6042 | `FlashEndProgram` | no | the flash fill must end with this program's end_fill |
| 6043 | `FlashEndDiscriminator` | no | the flash fill's closing instruction is not end_fill |
| 6044 | `FlashEndIntent` | no | the flash fill ends a different intent than it began |
| 6045 | `FlashEndOrder` | no | the flash fill's begin and end are out of order |
| 6046 | `ReceiverCannotReceive` | no | the receiver token account cannot receive: frozen, closed, not initialized, for another mint or owner, or with an extension other than ImmutableOwner |
| 6047 | `RefundCannotReceive` | no | the refund account cannot take the refund: frozen, for another mint or owner, or with a foreign delegate, close authority or extension |
| 6048 | `FeeAboveBound` | no | the current fees exceed the bound the solver accepted |
| 6049 | `ExtTooLong` | no | the extension data is too long |
| 6050 | `ExtMalformed` | no | the extension data is malformed: badly encoded, tags unsorted or repeated, or a partner with a zero key or zero bps |
| 6051 | `ExtUnknown` | no | the extension data holds a field the program does not know |
| 6052 | `FlagsUnknown` | no | the intent flags name options the program does not know |
| 6053 | `FillKindDisabled` | no | the admin stopped fills of this kind, and with them new claims and stand-by joins |
| 6054 | `UnsupportedVersion` | no | an account has a version this program does not support |
| 6055 | `AmountInMismatch` | no | the fill must sell exactly the intent's remaining amount |
| 6056 | `EpochRegression` | no | the signing epoch can only move forward |
| 6057 | `TreasuryMismatch` | no | the treasury account must be the configured fee recipient |
| 6058 | `CrankBountyTooHigh` | no | the crank bounty exceeds the program's maximum |
| 6059 | `CreateFeeTooHigh` | no | the create fee exceeds the program's maximum |
| 6060 | `PartnerCutTooHigh` | no | the partner cut must be at most 10000 bps |
| 6061 | `PartnerFeeTooHigh` | no | a partner fee can be at most 100 bps |
| 6062 | `PartnerAccountMissing` | yes | the partner has no token account for the input mint yet |
| 6063 | `PartnerAccountNotCanonical` | no | the partner fee must go to the partner's canonical token account |
| 6064 | `MandateInvalid` | no | the mandate's terms are unsound: kinds must be swap, limit or dutch |
| 6065 | `MandateExpired` | no | the mandate has expired |
| 6066 | `MandateKind` | no | the mandate does not allow this kind of intent |
| 6067 | `MandateTtl` | no | the intent lives longer than the mandate allows |
| 6068 | `MandateCap` | no | the intent draws more than the mandate's per-intent cap (amount sold plus agent fee) |
| 6069 | `MandateBudget` | no | the mandate's total budget would be exceeded |
| 6070 | `MandateCount` | no | the mandate has already created as many intents as it allows |
| 6071 | `MandatePrice` | no | the minimum output is below the price floor the owner set |
| 6072 | `MandateRevoked` | no | this mandate no longer stands: the owner revoked it, granted that id again, or advanced their signing epoch |
| 6073 | `MandateMismatch` | no | the intent differs from the mandate's fixed terms: same mints, no flags, the owner's partner only, and proceeds to an account the owner holds |
| 6074 | `CreateCostAboveCeiling` | yes | the engine's create fee or crank bounty rose above what this transaction allows |
| 6075 | `NonceJumpTooLarge` | no | one advance may move the nonce base at most 2^32 past its current value and never into the agent nonce lanes |
| 6076 | `EpochJumpTooLarge` | no | one advance may raise the signing epoch at most 2^48 |
| 6077 | `NotAProof` | no | the collaborative split settles only a proof intent that commits a spec hash |
| 6078 | `SplitCountMismatch` | no | the recipient wallets, their weights, and the passed token accounts must be equal in number and within the engine's recipient cap |
| 6079 | `RecipientNotCanonical` | no | each split recipient account must be the recipient wallet's canonical associated token account for the input mint |
| 6080 | `SplitNotConserved` | no | the split left lamports in the escrow |
| 6081 | `MintCapMissing` | no | this create or exit did not pass the input mint's cap account, which the engine needs when it requires caps and whenever escrow it counted leaves |
| 6082 | `MintCapMismatch` | no | the account passed as the mint cap is not the engine's writable cap account for the input mint |
| 6083 | `MintCapPerOrder` | no | the amount escrowed exceeds the per-order cap the engine set for the input mint |
| 6084 | `MintCapWindow` | yes | intents selling this mint have used the engine's escrow cap for the current window |
| 6085 | `MintCapInvalid` | no | a mint cap needs a per-order cap above zero, a window cap at least the per-order cap, and a window of at least 60 seconds |
| 6086 | `CommitteeInvalid` | no | a committee needs 1 to 8 distinct members in ascending order, a threshold from 1 to its member count, a fee wallet, and an address that is the hash of exactly those terms |
| 6087 | `CommitteeSigners` | no | the votes name fewer members than the committee's threshold, or a member it does not have |
| 6088 | `CommitteeMismatch` | no | the committee passed is not the judge the escrow names |
| 6089 | `ClaimTerms` | no | a claim's terms are out of bounds: at most 7 days and 100 SOL of stake, and a claim cannot run past the escrow's expiry |
| 6090 | `ClaimHeld` | yes | another worker holds this job's claim |
| 6091 | `ClaimsMissing` | no | this escrow takes claims, so a release or cancel must pass its claims board |
| 6092 | `ClaimsOpen` | no | this escrow already takes claims |
| 6093 | `NotClaimant` | no | only the worker holding the claim can drop it |
| 6094 | `StakeAccountMismatch` | no | the stake goes to the claimant when it is paid, otherwise to the escrow's owner |
| 6095 | `ProfileInvalid` | no | a profile needs 1 to 8 distinct lowercase skill tags of at most 16 letters, digits or dashes, an https endpoint of at most 128 printable characters, and a document url only together with its sha256 |
| 6096 | `ClaimCooldown` | yes | this worker dropped its claim on the job and may claim it again once that claim would have ended |
| 6097 | `ReleaseCannotSettle` | no | the judge fee leaves less of the escrow than the rounded-up protocol and partner fees, so no release could pay |
| 6098 | `LineWaiting` | yes | workers stand by for this job, so it goes to them in line order and cannot be claimed directly |
| 6099 | `LineEmpty` | no | nobody stands by for this job, so no line is left to advance |
| 6100 | `JobNotHeld` | no | nobody holds this job and nobody stands by, so claim it instead of standing by |
| 6101 | `LineEntryMismatch` | no | a line entry passed is not the line's next one, or a drop or advance passed none while workers wait |
| 6102 | `MintCapTotal` | yes | intents selling this mint already hold the engine's total escrow limit for it |
| 6103 | `CommitteeRequired` | no | this escrow reaches the committee floor the engine sets for its token, so its attestor must be a committee of at least 2 judges, passed with the create |
| 6104 | `CommitteeFloorsFull` | no | the engine already keeps a committee floor for as many tokens as it can |
| 6105 | `AccountOutdated` | no | an account has an earlier layout or version than this program reads |
| 6106 | `NotLegacy` | no | close-legacy closes only accounts of an earlier layout or version, and this one is current |
| 6107 | `LegacyPayeeMismatch` | no | close-legacy pays the wallet the account's layout records as its payer, or the config's fee recipient when it records none |
| 6108 | `LegacyVaultOpen` | no | close-legacy closes an intent only once its vault is gone |
| 6109 | `LegacyMigrates` | no | close-legacy never closes a config or user state |
| 6110 | `AlreadyCurrent` | no | migrate rewrites only accounts of an earlier layout or version, and this one is current |
| 6111 | `UnknownLayout` | no | migrate reads only the layouts earlier programs wrote |
| 6112 | `ConfigMissing` | no | migrating an open escrow reads the fee schedule from the config |
| 6113 | `LegacyLineOpen` | no | close-legacy never closes a claim board or stand-by entry of an open escrow, so the line keeps its order |
